description_en: Deletes a launch template in a specified region by specifying the LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName parameter
description_zh: 指定参数LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName删除目标地域下的一个实例启动模板
kebab_example: aliyun ecs delete-launch-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --launch-template-id lt-bp1apo0bbbkuy0rj0000 --launch-template-name testLaunchTemplateName --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLaunchTemplate

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the launch template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the launch template. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html.

You must specify `LaunchTemplateId` or `LaunchTemplateName` to determine the launch template
parameters.help_zh:
启动模板ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html。

您必须指定 `LaunchTemplateId` 或 `LaunchTemplateName` 以确定启动模板
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the launch template.

You must specify `LaunchTemplateId` or `LaunchTemplateName` to determine the launch template
parameters.help_zh:
启动模板名称。

您必须指定`LaunchTemplateId`或`LaunchTemplateName`以确定启动模板。
parameters.name: launch_template_name

LaunchTemplateId.description_en:
The ID of the launch template. For more information, see [DescribeLaunchTemplates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html）.

When you use a launch template to create instances, you must specify `LaunchTemplateId` or `LaunchTemplateName` to determine the launch template
LaunchTemplateId.description_zh:
启动模板ID。更多信息，请参见[DescribeLaunchTemplates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html）。

使用启动模板创建实例时，您必须指定`LaunchTemplateId`或`LaunchTemplateName`以确定启动模板
